title: Carer Visit Coverage
dataSources: Daily activity (`eldercare:activity`), fall alerts (`fall:alert`), medication reminders (`medreminder:event`), check-in calls (`checkin:call`), wandering alerts (`wandering:alert`).
app: Elder-care and accessibility telemetry — activity and fall sensors (Apple Watch fall detection, motion mats), medication dispensers, and check-in / video-call logs — streamed to Splunk HEC via APIs and smart-home hubs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=checkin:call type=visit
| bin _time span=1d
| stats count as visits, values(carer) as carers by _time
| eval covered=if(visits>0,1,0)
| stats sum(covered) as covered_days, count as total_days
| eval coverage_pct=round(100*covered_days/total_days,1)
description: Measures how many days had at least one in-person carer or family visit, revealing gaps in coverage.
value: Visible coverage gaps let a family rota fill the days nobody was scheduled to drop by.
implementation: Ingest visit logs into `index=personal`; compute the share of days with a visit.
grandmaExplanation: It shows which days had a visit and which had none, so the family can fill the gaps in caring.
